#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup
/area testing

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Now that the prow jobs invoke `test-e2e-sequential-extended-shard-0` and `-shard-1` directly (kubernetes/test-infra#37230), the parent target no longer needs to fan out to both shards. 

Revert `test-e2e-sequential-extended` to the plain single-run form, matching `test-e2e-extended`, and point the README CI-status entry at the per-shard testgrid tabs.

## Walkthrough

The PR refactors the `test-e2e-sequential-extended` Makefile target to invoke a parameterized runner rule instead of explicit shard sub-target invocations, and updates README documentation to reflect shard-specific testgrid links for extended test suites.

## Changes

**E2E Extended Test Execution**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**E2E extended target refactoring and exports** <br> `Makefile-test.mk`, `README.md`|Expanded shard-0 and shard-1 export sets to include the parent `test-e2e-sequential-extended`, changed the parent target to depend on `setup-e2e-env` and invoke `run-test-e2e-sequential-extended-%` using `E2E_KIND_VERSION`, and split README "Extended suites" into shard-0 and shard-1 links.|

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes
